description: Spacious and generous. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two sofas in the living zone along the right side; one facing inward toward the room, paired near the exterior windows. Dining table (6 seats). Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible, 15 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible, 15 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 2 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: households needing a single-level barrier-free path with no corridor turns; those wanting an open-plan kitchen directly adjacent to living windows.
